# Basecoat UI (vendored)

shadcn/ui look in plain HTML, CSS and JS. Not our code; do not edit these files, change `../../ui.css` instead.

- Source: https://github.com/hunvreus/basecoat (MIT, see LICENSE.md)
- Version: basecoat-css 1.1.0 (published 2026-10-23)
- Files, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/basecoat-css@1.1.0/dist/:
  - `basecoat.min.css` is `basecoat.cdn.min.css` (all components, Vega style)
  - `basecoat-all.min.js` is `js/all.min.js` (tabs, select, dropdown menu, toast, ...)
- Upgrade: download the same two files of the new version, replace them, open `hub/assets/ui/guide.html` in light and dark and check it.
